Direct answer: The latest version of the Tidewater database is 4.2, released on 3 March 2026.

Key findings: 
- Tidewater 4.2 is the latest stable release, adding online index rebuilds and a faster write-ahead log.
- The previous release, 4.1, came out in October 2025 and remains supported until 2027.
- Most of the advice for tuning Tidewater 3.8 also applies to later releases.

Source list:
1. Tidewater release notes - https://tidewater.example/releases
2. Tuning Tidewater for write-heavy loads - https://dbnotes.example/tidewater-tuning

Uncertainty or limitations: None.

- If you are currently using Tidewater 3.6, you may want to consider upgrading to the latest version, 4.2, for the new features and performance improvements.
- Before upgrading, ensure that you have a maintenance window available for the upgrade process, as your database is 200 GB.
- Consult the Tidewater release notes and tuning guide for more information on the upgrade process and any necessary configuration changes.

Direct answer: The Harbor H2 wireless headphones' battery lasts approximately 31 hours on a single charge with noise cancelling on.

Key findings: 
- The Harbor H2 headphones ran for 31 hours on one charge with noise cancelling on in a test.
- Charging from empty takes about two hours over USB-C.
- The ear cups are deep and stay comfortable through a long flight.

Direct answer: The Larkspur bridge opened to traffic in 1962.

Key findings:
- The Larkspur bridge was approved for repainting, with work expected to take five months and close one lane at a time.
- Cyclists will be diverted to the upstream footbridge during the repainting.
- A ferry service began at the Larkspur crossing in 1931, carrying up to forty cars an hour at its peak.
- The ferry house still stands on the east bank and is now a cafe.
- The Larkspur bridge carries four lanes and a footpath on each side.
- More than six hundred runners finished this year's Larkspur bridge run.
